Constraint / Qualifier: ER-/PR- and HER2- (not eligible for anti-HER2 therapy)
Documented deleterious or suspected deleterious germline mutation
Completed adequate breast and axilla surgery
Example EMR Text: Completed breast-conserving surgery with axillary clearance

Constraint / Qualifier: atleast cycles neoadjuvant/adjuvant chemo with anthracyclines/taxanes or both
Example EMR Text: Completed 6 cycles of doxorubicin and paclitaxel

Constraint / Qualifier: Prior treatment with PARP inhibitor (e.g., olaparib) or hypersensitivity
Prior second primary malignancy except non-melanoma skin, cervical CIS, DCIS, Stage I G1 endometrial carcinoma, or >5 years disease-free solid tumors/lymphomas
Concurrent use of strong/moderate inhibitors (2-week washout required)
Concurrent use of strong/moderate inducers (5-week washout for enzalutamide/phenobarbital; 3-week for others)
